snippet: The team at Mike's Union Auto are honest, fast and reasonably priced. I'm so grateful to have them nearby.
Doesn't have the equipment nor knowledge to fix high end cars but the people here are definitely fair and super nice!
Mikes Union Auto Repair is praised for its excellent service, and they are especially good at communicating in Chinese, making it convenient for Chinese-speaking customers.
Loaded up the baby and the car for a road trip....aaand we have a flat tire. These folks checked it out right away and fixed the problem in about ten minutes! Awesome.
As others have mentioned, these guys are absolutely the best! They're always willing to take my car in and they do a great job fixing it in a timely manner
Very friendly service! Had a tire repair done in a pinch, no problem at all.
Made a simple repair on very short notice and only charged $25. I didn't think it was possible to have anything done by a mechanic in SF for that price.
My car charging station just stoped charging my iphone. I dropped in today. They did a fantastic job checking and fixing that in 10 minutes!
FAKE REVIEWS! Do not waste your time. receptionist fielding calls is ignorant and causes their business to lose money. Work was shoddy and over-priced.
Great service. Readable prices.
I got very thorough used car inspection, they identified leaks in the engine and steering rack, noticed broken A/C. Bought the car anyway 😂 …
Quick and well-priced replacement of a knock sensor on my vehicle. Car is running good so far .. thankful for their help
Fast service, transparent pricing, and kind customer service. Plus, in the sunset so it's easier to fix your car up in the city
I’ve only had good luck with this place.  Family run, friendly and good service.  Only mechanic I go to in SF.
I had a simple repair that needed to be done, and I was welcomed by a group of good people that helped me in a matter of minutes. This is the kind of business SF needs to support!
Has quickly become my go-to shop for general repairs/maintenance. Great communication, good value, and solid service.
Very nice! My radiator cracked and was overheating, they were able to replace it in 3hrs and I was back on the road.
They are very fair and did a great job with my Mazda! Thanks
Good mechanic but watch for overcharging. Call around before you commit. They quoted me double what other mechanics in the area did.
The staff are nice and helpful. The prices are very reasonable and clear in breaking down their bill for parts and labor.
Friendly. Only had an oil change, but nothing to suggest they deserve less than 5 stars.
Great service. Even better price. Got everything done way ahead of schedule. Highly recommended!
Need to patch tire, called for wait time..done in 10mins and friendly service and decent value
Did a great job.  Hunted down rate parts and completed the work after hours.
This is a family run business that is honest about their quotes. I will go back again.
Fast, fair pricing, no bs
They're amazing, fast and super reliable
Price is not expensive.  Customer service is nice
So friendly and so fast! First time here but I'll be back.
Friendly staff, quick service
Great service
Helpful, quick, and a fair price.
Best customer service
Great services
Really great experience. Very transparent. I went in for service twice and the second time they really went above and beyond . I would come back again.

Had a wonderful experience at Mike's today getting a tire patch! They were able to fit me in right away and the the staff was super accommodating of my schedule for pickup. When it was time to get my car, they even parked it right outside …
Brought my car in for an oil change. It was easy to make an appointment over the phone. It was done in an hour and price was reasonable. Will go back again.
Kind-hearted and attentive to service

I tried calling, leaving voicemails, and texting in order to make an appointment and it took a week for them to get back to me via text. They informed me that they do not work on my particular VW even though the previous owner of the vehicle took it there for years. When I asked what had changed they did not respond (maybe the will get back to me in a week). Maybe they do good work but based on this experience I would take your car and money elsewhere.

Edit: I'm sorry I upset you. I called multiple times for multiple days before texting, that's what I was referring to when I said a week (though it may have been 8 days). Also, you never even asked me what type of work I needed done (you don't do oil changes?) and you never got back to me on what had changed until seeing this review which is a strange way to respond to the question. I'm glad business is going well for you guys and I wish you the best. I found a mechanic closer to me who had no trouble finding the parts and helping me out with general maintenance (and they don't even claim to be European car specialist).

Rude jerks always parked illegally and driving customer cars dangerously. Would avoid.
Cute dog though.
